name: dase-hub
description: DASE Hub — central dashboard for the UIC Digital Accessibility team's projects

scripts.build: npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./styles/input.css -o ./styles/tailwind.css --minify && esbuild ./index.ts --bundle --platform=node --outdir=dist --external:@aws-sdk --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=hono/jsx --loader:.tsx=tsx --loader:.css=text --minify && cd dist && zip -r lambda.zip * > /dev/null && aws --profile equalifyuic lambda update-function-code --function-name dase-hub --zip-file "fileb://lambda.zip" > /dev/null && rm -rf lambda.zip
